question: Does the qualified R21 antipodal-separation sufficiency result transfer when the fixed actual-108 sampled state is replaced by the exact exhaustive sixteen-context state for every surface?
hypothesis: R21 antipodal separation is structurally sufficient rather than a finite-sample artifact: on the exhaustive state, all 128 antipodal-separating partitions will reproduce full-five-coordinate membership in all four phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate projections with no false negative, while at least one of the 6307 nonseparating partitions will also match one or more panels, preserving the sufficient-not-necessary classification.

prior_evidence.observation: On the fixed actual-108 state, all 128 antipodal-separating balanced partitions matched all four derived-coordinate panels; among 6307 nonseparating partitions, 6272 matched all four and 35 matched zero, yielding zero false negatives and 6272 false positives.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one R21 dimension: the record state changes from a 108-observation sampled prefix per surface to one exact observation of each of the sixteen latent contexts per surface. The exhaustive balanced-partition enumeration, binary cardinality, tuple width, four derived-coordinate panels, exact set equality, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.r21_actual108_replication_control: Run the unchanged local deterministic R21 probe and require antipodal_separation_sufficient_not_necessary with its exact positive and negative match cardinalities before R22 output.
arms_and_inputs.exhaustive_state: For each of nine entities and three surface families, include each context_index 0..15 exactly once, yielding 432 records and sixteen records per surface.
arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Represent exhaustive records by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.partition_enumeration: Enumerate masks 0..65535 in ascending order; retain exactly popcount-eight masks with bit zero clear, yielding 6435 unique unlabeled balanced partitions.
arms_and_inputs.antipodal_law: A retained partition is law-positive iff bit(q) differs from bit(q+8) for every q in 0..7. Exactly 128 partitions are positive and exactly 6307 are negative.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: For each retained mask in ascending order, evaluate [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], and [bucket,suffix1], for exactly 25740 arms. Every arm uses identical exhaustive records.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.exhaustive_arm: none; every latent context is enumerated exactly once
seeds.r21_control: Exact frozen R6-R21 seed formula inside the unchanged R21 replication.

controls: The unchanged local deterministic R21 probe must reproduce antipodal_separation_sufficient_not_necessary, 128 separating all-four matches, zero separating partial or zero matches, 6272 nonseparating all-four matches, zero nonseparating partial matches, 35 nonseparating zero matches, zero false negatives, and 6272 false positives before R22 output.
The exhaustive full-five-coordinate control must reproduce 432 records, sixteen distinct contexts per surface, nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
Enumeration must produce exactly 6435 distinct balanced masks with bit zero clear, including exactly 128 antipodal-separating and exactly 6307 nonseparating masks.
Every retained mask must be balanced 8/8 and independently reconstructed; all 25740 arms run once in ascending mask then derived-coordinate order.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R21 probe reproduces its frozen classification and exact law cardinalities before R22 output.
Each surface contains every context index 0..15 exactly once and no sampled record.
All 25740 projections are constructed from identical exhaustive records with exactly one binary phase bucket and one declared derived coordinate.
Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.exhaustive_antipodal_law_invariant: Validity and controls pass; all 128 antipodal-separating partitions match all four panels, all 6307 nonseparating partitions match zero panels, and both false-negative and false-positive counts are zero.
classification_rules.exhaustive_antipodal_separation_sufficie: Validity and controls pass; every antipodal-separating partition matches all four panels and at least one nonseparating partition matches one or more panels.
classification_rules.exhaustive_antipodal_separation_not_suff: Validity and controls pass; at least one antipodal-separating partition fails one or more panels.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R21, exhaustive full-five-coordinate, enumeration, balance, complement-normalization, uniqueness, or construction control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed 25740-arm panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, enumeration-cardinality, arm-cardinality, projection, context-completeness, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R21 replication, exhaustive-state construction, full-five-coordinate control, exhaustive partition enumeration, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R22 output begins, complete all 25740 arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not filter partitions, alter records or formulas, inspect alternate states, or change controls, metrics, thresholds, capacity, or classification after observing R22 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, record state, partition, enumeration rule, antipodal law, derived coordinate, budget, context construction, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R22 output.
